title: Stress-family sleeves, round 2 (program config/gen359_program.json): 4 trials

trials.A residual crash reversal (BTC-hedged): 60 coins, daily residual = coin return - 60-day beta x BTC return (beta lagged); residual < -3 x its 90-day sd (lagged) -> long the coin 0.1 and short beta x 0.1 BTC for 3 days (at most 8 open); BTC itself excluded
trials.B equity-stress buy: CME ES daily return (US trade date d) < -2.5 x its 250-day sd (lagged) -> long BTC and ETH 0.25 each from 00:00 UTC of d+1 for 3 days
trials.C VIX-spike buy: VIX daily close up > 25% vs the previous close -> long BTC and ETH 0.25 each from 00:00 UTC of the next day for 3 days
trials.D market-wide capitulation: an hour in which at least 8 of the 60 coins have a perp premium z < -3 -> long BTC and ETH 0.25 each for the next 12 h

costs: per-coin Bybit costs and Bybit funding (stressbook.pnl), limit-order execution (Gen337 rule) for every trial
bars: program entry bar: DEV (2020-22) > 0, TEST >= 0.8, HOLD >= 0.5, |corr v8.6| <= 0.2, |corr with the Gen359 book| <= 0.5; passing trials get robustness checks before any book decision
